display_long_description:
# BIG THINGS ARE IN STORE

Vote is gearing up for its next chapter! A major update is in the works for the coming months, with fresh polls and new head-to-head questions. Stay tuned — what's in store is worth the wait.

# CAST YOUR VOTE

Step into Vote, the free VR voting simulator for Meta Quest 2, 3, 3S and Pro. Whatever the question, pick your side, cast your ballot, and track real-time results as people around the world vote with you. It's not just sports — it's all sorts of things. Make your voice count!

All eligible votes can claim a free game discount code at the end of the experience.

Key Features:
- Vote on head-to-head questions on all sorts of topics
- Track real-time voting results from around the world
- Immersive VR visuals to enhance the experience
- Free on Meta Quest 2, 3, 3S and Pro

# WHILE YOU WAIT, TRY OUR OTHER WORLDS

Face the haunted chapters of **Exorcism of the Legion (Last Rites)**, or team up against an evolving alien in **BlackGate**, our 4v1 multiplayer horror game. Find both from Fun Train on the Meta Quest store.

This is a virtual voting simulator and is not an official voting platform. Votes cast in 'Vote' do not have any standing in the real-world . 'Vote' is a product of Megaverse LLC, a Fun Train company. All rights reserved. © 2025 Megaverse LLC. Unauthorized use, duplication, or distribution of this material without express and written permission from Megaverse LLC is strictly prohibited.
